description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison between two models, Flan-T5-783M and GPT-4, across six different tasks, with the tasks categorized on the horizontal axis and the performance scores on the vertical axis. The horizontal axis is labeled with six task names: TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1), while the vertical axis is labeled with a scale ranging from 25 to 85, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. Each task is represented by a pair of bars, with Flan-T5-783M in blue and GPT-4 in red, and the bars are grouped by task. The performance scores for Flan-T5-783M range from 31.9 to 82.8, with the highest score achieved in TriviaQA (F1) and the lowest in HotPotQA (EM), while the scores for GPT-4 range from 32.5 to 83.8, with the highest score also in TriviaQA (F1) and the lowest in HotPotQA (EM). The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the performance differences between the two models across the various tasks.
